elementName: Type of means of transport identification

values.name: Car with caravan
values.description: A caravan towed by a car.

values.name: Exceptional transport
values.description: Transport for which common characteristics are not applicable (e.g. big transformers requiring special wagons, special tackles, special routing etc.).

values.name: Road tanker
values.description: An over-the-road tank trucker or trailer.

values.name: Pipeline
values.description: A line of pipes for conveying water, gas, oil, etc.

values.name: Hydrant cart
values.description: Vehicle used at large airports with installed distribution systems to make into-plane deliveries of fuel; distinguished from other types of fuelling vehicles.
